data.one_liner: Dart package providing simple access to the CoinGecko API (Version 3).
data.what_it_does: Provides an asynchronous API wrapper divided into sections matching the CoinGecko API documentation. Allows fetching cryptocurrencies prices, coin data, historical market charts, exchanges, derivatives, NFTs, and global data.
use_when: You need to fetch cryptocurrency market data, prices, or NFT stats from CoinGecko in your Dart or Flutter application.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose HTTP client or a backend client other than CoinGecko.
strengths: Organized into sections mirroring the official CoinGecko API documentation
Uses CoinGeckoResult objects to easily handle success and error states
weaknesses: Tied exclusively to a single third-party API (CoinGecko)

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer making custom raw HTTP requests instead of using a dedicated wrapper package.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a powerful HTTP client with interceptors for custom API integrations.
